title: ID0461945-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313483122003] CU logs check
description:
Reported behavior/issue- CU logs check
Solution: Logs analysis provided

additional_info.subject: case notes
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Is it possible to check logs on the charger n. 313483122003 on yesterday 14 of October between 7:00 p.m. and 7:20 p.m. (CU Time) ? A customer called us because she tried to charge 3 times, and said that the recharges were approved, but were 0 recharges. But we can't see any recharge or authorization on this charger at this time.
Could you please check?
Thank you in advance.

Good evening Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0461945.
I checked the charger
Y2/S1 313483122003
on 14.11.2025 between 18:45 and19:00, and there is no activity on the charger. It is only reported that the charger was offline from OCPP Backend side.
The connection with OCPP Backend was lost at
2025-11-14T18:12:59
and recovered at 2025-11-14T19:15:00 after the reboot.
Hope this analysis provided you with clarification.
Please let me know if further support is required. I will proceed to close the ticket once feedback is received.
